name: Vermelia
source:
Vermelia Isengrim 
Greater Unicorn (Monoceros inauratus)

Age: 40 (Approximate, exact age withheld)

A mysterious woman who has seemingly been everywhere and done everything, yet lives in solitude amongst her accumulated wealth. Fond of microbiology. 

Fun fact: She possesses a revoked medical license.
